# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

## Punjabi (pa)

Script: Gurmukhi. Used in Punjab and Chandigarh, and spoken in Delhi and
Haryana.
Tone: everyday spoken Punjabi.
Words: ਆਨਲਾਈਨ, ਫਾਰਮ, ਪੋਰਟਲ, ਲੌਗਇਨ, ਆਧਾਰ, ਬੈਂਕ, ਮੋਬਾਈਲ, OTP, ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ, ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ,
ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ, ਅਪਲੋਡ.
UI: ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਓ, ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰੋ, ਅੱਗੇ, ਪਿੱਛੇ, ਖੋਜੋ, ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰੋ, ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ, ਭਾਸ਼ਾ, ਮਦਦ.
Offices: ਤਹਿਸੀਲਦਾਰ, ਪਟਵਾਰੀ, ਸੇਵਾ ਕੇਂਦਰ, ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਪੰਚਾਇਤ, ਡਿਪਟੀ ਕਮਿਸ਼ਨਰ.
Gender: ਲਿੰਗ. Money: ₹6,000; ₹8 ਲੱਖ. September: ਸਤੰਬਰ.

## Odia (or)

Script: Odia. Used in Odisha.
Tone: everyday spoken Odia.
Words: ଅନଲାଇନ, ଫର୍ମ, ପୋର୍ଟାଲ, ଲଗଇନ, ଆଧାର, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ, ମୋବାଇଲ, OTP, ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ, ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ,
ଡାଉନଲୋଡ, ଅପଲୋଡ.
UI: ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଦାଖଲ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ, ପଛକୁ, ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ, ସେୟାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ସେଟିଂସ୍, ଭାଷା, ସାହାଯ୍ୟ.
Offices: ତହସିଲଦାର, ବିଡିଓ, ଗ୍ରାମ ପଞ୍ଚାୟତ, ଜିଲ୍ଲାପାଳ (କଲେକ୍ଟର), ମୋ ସେବା କେନ୍ଦ୍ର.
Gender: ଲିଙ୍ଗ. Money: ଟ.6,000; ଟ.8 ଲକ୍ଷ. September: ସେପ୍ଟେମ୍ବର.

items.t: Log in with Student Login and complete the form: course, fees, loan amount needed, co-borrower details, and a bank branch in your home district.
Upload the documents in the sizes shown and submit. You cannot edit after the final submit.
Your institution checks the documents, then the Higher Education Department, and the application goes to the bank.
The bank checks it, you and the co-borrower sign the loan agreement, and the loan is sanctioned. SMS and email tell you, and the bank gives you the card.

Fees go directly to the institution and living costs to your account. Repay over up to 15 years, starting one year after the course or job; paying the interest during studies earns a 1% interest concession.
1800-102-8014 (WBSCC State Help Desk, toll-free); SCC Grievance app on Google Play for complaints
Mukhya Mantri Swasthya Bima Yojana (MMSBY Card, formerly Swasthya Sathi)
State Health Agency, Health & Family Welfare Department, West Bengal

West Bengal's own health cover for families who had a Swasthya Sathi card but are not on the central Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) list. It gives cashless treatment of up to Rs.5 lakh a year for the whole family at empanelled government and private hospitals, in the state and outside it. Swasthya Sathi is being replaced since Ayushman Bharat started in West Bengal on 16 August 2026: families on the PM-JAY list get the Ayushman card, and the rest move to MMSBY. You check which one is yours with your Aadhaar number on the State Health Agency website, then enrol with your Swasthya Sathi card number.
Up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless
Your family was enrolled under Swasthya Sathi and you have the 17-character number (URN) printed on the Swasthya Sathi card
Your family is not on the Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY list. If it is, you get the Ayushman card instead, not MMSBY
Permanent resident of West Bengal. Families earning more than Rs.8 lakh a year are left out
Not for families covered by WBHS, CGHS, ESI or a PSU or government group medical scheme, or employees and pensioners who get a medical allowance
Members aged 70 and above get the separate Ayushman Vay Vandana card instead
No limit on family size, and illnesses you already have are covered from the first day
Aadhaar card of each family member being enrolled
Swasthya Sathi card, for the 17-character URN number
The mobile number registered with the Swasthya Sathi card, for the OTP
Aadhaar-linked mobile number of each member, for creating the ABHA health ID
Voter ID card (EPIC) of each adult member, with the AC, part and serial number from the voter list
Digital ration card number and its category (RKSY-I or RKSY-II), if you have one
PAN card number (optional)
State Health Agency, West Bengal
Aadhaar Number (Check Status)
Type any family member's Aadhaar and press Check Status first. The answer tells you whether your family is under PM-JAY or can enrol in MMSBY.
Swasthya Sathi URN
The 17-character number on your Swasthya Sathi smart card. An OTP is sent to the mobile number that was given when the card was made.
District / Block or ULB / Gram Panchayat or Ward
Bankura / Sonamukhi / Rangamati GP
These come filled in from the Swasthya Sathi record. Change them only if the family now lives somewhere else.
Shefali Mondal
Usually the eldest woman of the family, in whose name the Swasthya Sathi card was made.
Member Aadhaar (Validate)
For each member card, type that person's Aadhaar and press Validate. Members who are not eligible are struck off automatically.
Category and Ration Card No.
The category and number printed on your digital ration card. If you choose a category, the ration card number becomes compulsory.
Aadhaar Linked Mobile
The mobile number linked to this member's Aadhaar. The OTP for the ABHA health ID comes here.
Create ABHA ID
Generated
Press Create ABHA ID for every member and enter the OTP. The form will not submit until each eligible member has an ABHA ID.
EPIC Number / AC / Part / Serial Number
Copy these from the voter card and the voter list (the AC, part and serial number are shown on the voter slip or the ECI website).
Receiving Authority Name / Designation / Contact
Bina Roy / Health Assistant / 90000 72811
The official or help-desk staff taking your enrolment, for example at a camp or hospital desk, fills in their own details. If you are applying alone and unsure, call 1800-345-5384 before you submit.
Open sha.wbhealth.gov.in, tap Apply for MMSBY, type an Aadhaar number of the family and press Check Status. If it says your family is under PM-JAY, make the Ayushman card instead.
If you can enrol in MMSBY, type the 17-character Swasthya Sathi URN, press Submit URN and enter the OTP sent to the card's registered mobile.
The family details appear already filled in. Check the address, district, block and Gram Panchayat or ward.
For each member, press Validate on the Aadhaar, fill the ration card, mobile, gender, date of birth and voter details, and press Create ABHA ID.
Fill the receiving authority box and press Submit Enrollment. Note down the message shown on the screen.
The health department then does field verification and e-KYC. When the card is activated, you can be treated cashless at any empanelled hospital by showing it at the help desk.
If the hospital asks for money for a covered treatment, or you get stuck, call 1800-345-5384 (24 hours).
1800-345-5384 (State Health Agency West Bengal, 24x7, toll-free); 14555 (Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY call centre)
